About us

Infraconcept is an engineering company with 17+ years of experience in playgrounds, sports zones and urban environments. Certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, member of the Bulgarian Construction Chamber.

We combine own production (Innoflex, Epoxy) with official representation of leading European brands — to deliver complete, certified and durable solutions.
